items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 13 May 2026 12:28pm
items.description:
##Today##

Often cloudy during the morning with some showers, these showers heavy in places but will move through quickly in the wind. Showers then becoming isolated in the afternoon with sunny intervals developing.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 6°C and max. air temperature 12°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

2-7


##Wind Speed##

26


##Wind Direction##

NW


##Wind##

W or NW, quickly veering NW 20-32, veering N or NW 15-25 overnight into Thursday.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in showers. Isolated hill fog in showers.


##Comments##

Strong winds. Risk heavy showers.


##Tomorrow##
